name: Sku Unique Within Site
description: Where SKU is used as a canonical inventory/catalog identifier, it must be unique within the Site scope defined by the store policy.
purpose: Where SKU is used as a canonical inventory/catalog identifier, it must be unique within the Site scope defined by the store policy.

requirements.description: Where SKU is used as a canonical inventory/catalog identifier, it must be unique within the Site scope defined by the store policy.
The rule must be evaluated from authoritative server-side state and must not trust browser-calculated or provider-reported state without required validation/reconciliation.

failure.notes: Phase 12 defines the domain error identifier. HTTP mapping and response envelopes are reserved for Phase 18.

relationships.description: This rule constrains commerce.product operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.productVariant operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.inventoryItem operations or state.

valid: An operation involving commerce.product, commerce.productVariant satisfies the rule before authoritative state is committed.
invalid: An implementation bypasses commerce.rule.skuUniqueWithinSite and commits a conflicting or unverifiable state.

implementationNotes: Enforce at the server-side commerce domain boundary.
Use canonical Phase 11 schemas as the data model; do not create shadow transaction models.
If provider behavior differs, translate through an adapter and reconcile to canonical NEXT F state.
